from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper in the collection, capturing its title and which other papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references: list[str] | None = Field(description="A list of titles of other papers explicitly referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all papers parsed from the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
